$comment: S30 BMTC and Namma Metro static GTFS (T029). Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s30.yaml; rules: decision D115.

fields.name: feed_id
fields.meaning: bmtc or bmrcl, one per pinned Vonter repository commit

fields.name: service_date
fields.meaning: local (Asia/Kolkata) service date whose calendar and calendar_dates run the trip

fields.name: stop_id
fields.meaning: stop_times.stop_id (BMRCL: platform with a parent station)

fields.name: arrival_sec
fields.meaning: seconds after noon minus 12 h of service_date; may exceed 86400; null with missing_reason not_reported when blank

fields.name: departure_sec
fields.meaning: seconds after noon minus 12 h of service_date; may exceed 86400

valid_at: null: scheduled timetable entries; the scheduled instant is service_date plus seconds, never a live position or ETA
published_at: the pinned commit time of the feed
quality_flags: imputed where timepoint is 0 (BMRCL times approximated by the compiler)
